title: The Whisper
narration: twenty-five billion kilometers away, Voyager one went silent in November two thousand twenty-three, sending static. After months, it came back.
visual_goal: Deep space star field with tiny glowing point, slow zoom.

title: Leaving Home
narration: Launched nineteen seventy-seven, it flew by Jupiter (Io's volcanoes), Saturn (rings, Titan haze), then slingshotted outward, first human object to leave the solar system.
visual_goal: NASA archival montage: launch, Jupiter, Io, Saturn, Titan.

title: Crossing the Boundary
narration: In twenty twelve, it crossed the heliopause, becoming the first interstellar traveler, moving seventeen kilometers per second (thirty-eight thousand miles per hour), faster than a bullet.
visual_goal: Animated diagram of heliopause crossing, starfield rushing past.

title: The Golden Record
narration: On board: a gold-plated disc with greetings, music, images, a heartbeat. Our message: 'We were here.' One chance to get it right.
visual_goal: Close-up of Golden Record rotating, Earth in background.

title: The Last Light
narration: Instruments will stop by two thousand twenty-five, but it will drift silent for billions of years, carrying our first hello. The record speaks for U.S..
visual_goal: Instruments dimming, tiny dot receding into starfield.
